inputModel: The session pins, steward, registry writer and finality-proof pins are verifier-owned. railRegistryIndex uses CORE's RegistryIndexSnapshot and RegistryIndexEntry shape as a projection of the DACS-4 numeric snapshot; its revision is the session's railRegistryVersion. railRegistryIndexReceipts and railDefinitionReceipts list every carrier found for each binding. The definition receipt is matched by nativeAddress to the selected entry's anchor locator. Receipt blockRef.timestamp is CORE SR2-6 consensus time in unix ms. The verifier implements PA-2 single-signer rails only; PA-1 in-code and PA-3 multisig rails are indeterminate here.
